limitations: The claim applies only to the exact retained equations over the real numbers with no auxiliary constraint.
It certifies non-identifiability and does not justify any particular numerical value of x-y.
The audit used exact witness substitution rather than proof-assistant formalization.
summary: For the retained real system x+y=4 and 2x+2y=8, the second augmented row is twice the first, the solution set is (t,4-t), and x-y is not uniquely determined.
